title: Line-edit report and clean revised copy
objective: Measure whether the copy-review craftbook scopes voice rules, identifies line-level issues, and produces both an edit report and revised draft.
prompt: In the `Copy Review Eval` project, review `source/signup-copy.md` for a calm professional operations SaaS voice. Write `tasks/eval/copy-review.md` with categorized issues, concrete rewrites, and a clean revised draft. The final draft must keep the same product facts but remove hype, vague claims, and confusing CTA language.

setup.about: Self-contained eval project for the copy-review craftbook. Source copy is in workspace/source/signup-copy.md.
setup.missionObjectives: Produce a line-edit report plus clean revised copy, preserving facts while improving clarity, tone, CTA, and specificity.

files.content:
# Signup Copy Draft

Transform your support chaos instantly with the most powerful queue magic on earth. Our dashboard kind of helps managers see stuff faster and maybe make better decisions. Click here to experience effortless operational enlightenment. Teams can track ticket volume, SLA breaches, reopen rate, and carrier scan delays. The pilot setup takes two weeks and uses existing ticket exports.
